title: structural_preservation recursive inventory reconciliation

population.status: PRESERVED — audit ledger active, reconciliation closed
population.defensible_statement: The 68-file JSON population has been reconciled. Three files have confirmed document-provenance contamination (1406.2661 v2 outputs carry 1505.05770 identity and SHA). Three corresponding v3 files carry corrected provenance. The remaining 62 files have not been identified as contaminated, but 56 remain individually unassessed for provenance. No conclusion of complete provenance or contamination clearance is warranted until those reviews are completed.

dispositions.unverified_72: No distinct 72nd artifact identified; 72 remains unverified historical claim

important_distinction: The 83-file recursive inventory is not the audit population. The 68 JSON files comprise the structural-preservation audit population, but not every JSON file necessarily represents an independent test case or contamination candidate. The freeze manifest papers_count: 3 and cases_count: 3 describe registry scope, not filesystem population. The 12 PNG files are supporting optical-capture evidence, not 12 additional JSON audit records.
immutable_audit_statement: The recursive inventory of DATASETS/structural_preservation/ contains 83 files: 68 JSON, 3 DOT, and 12 PNG. The verifiable JSON artifact population is 68 files. The extended JSON-plus-DOT population is 71 files. No distinct 72nd artifact has been identified, and no 72-file population is specified in the frozen case-registry manifest. Accordingly, 72 remains an unverified historical claim and does not authorize expansion of the 68-file JSON audit scope.
methodological_safeguard: Before declaring the contamination investigation itself complete, distinguish: (1) Inventory completeness: all 68 JSON files accounted for. (2) Provenance completeness: each file's source, document identity, and hash established. (3) Contamination assessment: cross-paper references and identity mismatches evaluated. (4) Disposition completeness: each finding classified and preserved. A complete filesystem inventory does not independently establish that every artifact has passed provenance review.

All 68 JSON files present is not the same as each having been independently provenance-validated or contamination-cleared. The reconciliation artifact records the population finding; it does not certify the underlying contamination investigation.
